facts.fact: HISP Rwanda reports that a strategic meeting on 15 April 2026, chaired by the Ministry of Public Health's Secretary-General, committed to a patient-centred electronic medical record (DME) with HISP Rwanda as technical assistant, and lists integration with existing national systems, notably DHIS2, among its intended benefits; no timetable, pilot site or budget is stated.
